instruction: Copy file 'source.txt' to 'backup.txt' in each of directories 'dir1', 'dir2', 'dir3'.

parameters.command: rm -rf dir1 dir2 dir3 && mkdir dir1 dir2 dir3 && echo 'Source data 1' > dir1/source.txt && echo 'Source data 2' > dir2/source.txt && echo 'Source data 3' > dir3/source.txt

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'for d in dir1 dir2 dir3; do if [ -f "$d/backup.txt" ] && [ -f "$d/source.txt" ]; then echo "Success: backup.txt created in $d."; else echo "Failure: backup not completed in $d."; fi; done'
